text.en:
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 551 August 8, 1979
DIRECTING THAT THE POWERS OF ADMINISTRATIVE SUPERVISION AND CONTROL OF THE
OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT OVER THE BOARD OF ENERGY SHALL BE EXERCISED THROUGH
THE MINISTRY OF ENERGY
By virtue of the powers vested in me by law, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, do
hereby order that the powers of administrative supervision and control of the Office of the President over the
Board of Energy under Section 9 of Presidential Decree No. 1206 shall be exercised by the President through
the Minister of Energy.
Done in the City of Manila, this 8th day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-nine.
